brief.style: Instrumental, 144 BPM, 2000s melodic punk rock guitar trio, instrumental guitar theme, A major, four-four. Bright close-picked electric guitar, palm-muted downstrokes with funky gaps, fast electric bass and live acoustic kit. A short answering guitar riff gives way to clear open power chords and a bright picked lead above the band. A short band stop, dynamic tom and snare fills and a return of the guitar melody. Tight decisive final band chord with natural amplifier decay. Electric guitars, electric bass and acoustic kit, no vocals, no singing, no choir, no spoken words.
